rationale: dual_domain_n2i-claude-agentic: warm_start=True, pretrain_epochs=4, n_iter=18, grad_clip=1.0, unet_c=24, lr=0.0003, batch_size=1, train_n=200, val_n=214, outer_wall_s=1300, per_scene_s=None, seed=42, rationale=dual_domain_n2i iter-8 (search-20260619-01, PER-IMAGE Noise2Inverse: warm-start pre-pass + per-scan Adam fit; NEVER amortized). SIX-BOX (NUMBERS, from iter-1..7 observations). (1) TRAJECTORY both per-scan levers + warm-start depth now MAPPED with bracketed interior optima: lr {1e-3 hr0 (drift), 3e-4 hr0.1976 BEST, 1.5e-4 hr0.1207 iter-6 REGRESSED} optimum 3e-4; n_iter {15 hr0.1506, 18 hr0.1976 BEST, 20 hr0.1595 iter-5 REGRESSED} optimum 18; pretrain_epochs {1 hr0, 4 hr0.1976 BEST, 6 hr0.1870 iter-7 REGRESSED} optimum 4. iter-4 (pe4,n18,lr3e-4,unet_c16) hr 0.1976 SSIM 0.9277 PSNR 35.99 RMSE 7.934e-4 elapsed 1235.5s is the joint optimum + run best (BASE_ITER=4). (2) LIMITER: all three scalar levers (lr, n_iter, pretrain_epochs) are spent/wrong-signed at their bracketed optima. The half-view info bound is the leading hypothesis, BUT one genuinely-untried single knob remains: per-scan U-Net CAPACITY at the now-anchored lr. unet_c has been HELD at 16 for ALL 7 corrected-campaign iters; the only c16->c32 datapoint (campaign-state note: flat at 0.9508) is from the DISCARDED boundary-slice run AND was at lr=1e-3 -- the DRIFT regime where the per-scan fit leaves the init, so capacity could not carry through (same confound that made iter-2 pretrain_epochs-up misread). Capacity has NEVER been tested at the anchored lr=3e-4/n_iter=18 optimum where the fit refines NEAR the FBP-consistent init. (3) ONE KNOB: unet_c 16 -> 24 (lr=3e-4, n_iter=18, pretrain_epochs=4, grad_clip=1.0, warm_start=True, val_n=214, seed=42 ALL HELD at iter-4 BEST; the 2-subset even/odd angular split is hard-wired in geometry.py::split_angles and is NOT a cfg knob, so it cannot be the lever without editing a shared module -- forbidden). outer_wall_s 1080 -> 1300 is a FORCED anti-truncation consequence of the larger net (not a tuning knob): the per-scene fit time rises with capacity, and at outer_wall_s=1080 per_scene_s=5.05s with only 0.45s margin over the c16 4.60s/scene would silently truncate; 1300 gives per_scene_s=6.07s, comfortably above the expected ~5.5s/scene at c24, so ALL 214 scenes complete 18 steps with NO truncation. (4) HYPOTHESIS: unet_c 16->24 at the anchored lr=3e-4/n_iter=18 optimum lifts hr above 0.1976 (PSNR above 35.99) because a higher-capacity per-scan denoiser carries a richer FBP-consistent prior through the 18-step refine (lr anchors it near the init; this is the refine regime, not drift). NUMERIC FALSIFIER: if hr <= 0.1976 (no PSNR gain over 35.99), per-scan capacity is NOT the binding constraint at the anchored lr and per-image U-Net N2I ceilings at hr~0.20 on dense 2304-view Mayo -- the half-view info-loss bound (the even/odd split discards half the 2304 views) -> hr 0.1976 @iter-4 is the per-image N2I half-view ceiling; document it (NAF/ram structural-negative class), no further per-image tuning. (5) BUDGET (HARD 20-min compute, val=ALL 214): unet_c adds U-Net forward/backward per step; the per-step wall is dominated by the c-INDEPENDENT 2304-view FBP forward+adjoint, so the c16->c24 increase is a fraction of each step. Conservative +20% on the c16 fit loop: 985s -> ~1182s; + overhead ~267s (warm-start 4ep + setup/score) = ~1449s compute; + figure ~27s = ~1476s = 24.6 min figure-inclusive, 324s (5.4 min) under the 1800s/30-min SLURM hard wall. Fit loop ~1182s < outer_wall_s=1300 backstop; per-scene ~5.5s < per_scene_s=1300/214=6.07s -> NO truncation. grad_clip=1.0 mandatory (2304-view FBP adjoint overflows otherwise). val_n=214 NOT reduced (protocol). 321px detector-geometry FOV default (no fov=False). staged_canonical / v3 mayo_ldct_fitted / per-sample-ps half-angle projector swap / bg_target=truth hard-wired. PER-IMAGE structure UNCHANGED (warm-start pre-pass + per-scan fit; NEVER amortized). (6) no control return.
